snippet.title: Bandit Trap - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Defend your home using inventive boobytraps as the Trapper, or team up as three sneaky Bandits and try to escape with the loot! Watch the latest Bandit Trap trailer to see gameplay from this upcoming 3v1 online multiplayer game bursting with pranks and physics-driven mayhem. Bandit Trap will be available on PC via Steam and Epic Games Store.
